senses.sense_definition: The statistical study of human populations, focusing on their size, structure, and changes over time.

examples.text: The professor specializes in the <w>demography</w> of aging societies in Europe.
Government policies are often shaped by current trends in national <w>demography</w>.

senses.sense_definition: The specific statistical composition or makeup of a particular population.

examples.text: The school's <w>demography</w> began to change with the arrival of many new immigrant families.
Marketing teams analyze the local <w>demography</w> before opening a new store in the area.

senses.sense_definition: The study of population dynamics and structure in non-human species.

examples.text: Ecologists track the <w>demography</w> of endangered insect species to prevent their extinction.
Understanding the <w>demography</w> of local plant life helps researchers manage forest health.
